profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company headquartered in Dublin and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001467373, trading under the ticker ACN. On its own site the company describes itself as embracing change to create value for its clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, working across industries and using emerging technologies alongside what it calls human ingenuity.

Much of the site's material is framed around AI. Accenture describes Accenture Construct as a new global business that brings together advisory, engineering, delivery, digital and AI to orchestrate capital projects from strategy through execution and operation. Other site content covers redesigning work and skills so that people and AI work together, the strain AI-driven power demand places on grids and how data center developers are responding, and cyber resilience in an AI-driven threat landscape. The site also states that Accenture helps the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships scale AI across global operations.

The company's profile records no litigation and no separately tracked AI products or MCP servers under its name.
